title: HUDOC Researcher — ECtHR Case-Law Search & RAG
description: Source-first research environment for European Court of Human Rights case law. HUDOC Researcher combines paragraph-level structural search, judgment reading, citation analytics, case statistics, and semantic retrieval evaluated against the Court's official Case-Law Guides. Court source materials remain subject to Council of Europe / ECtHR terms and are not re-licensed by this project.
